brief.audience: People who value a calm, sensory morning skincare routine.
brief.promise: A natural beauty soap can turn everyday washing into a simple, peaceful ritual without implying health or medical benefits.
brief.setting: Minimal sunlit bathroom with a ceramic sink, pale stone surfaces, natural wood and subtle botanical accents.
brief.lighting: Soft diffused morning light, warm neutral palette, gentle highlights on water and foam.
brief.cameraMotion: Slow macro push-ins, controlled side slides and steady overhead movement.
brief.pacing: Unhurried sensory cuts every 3–5 seconds, synchronized with narration and ending on a clean ritual image.
